title: automate-kms-hsm-tls-rotation-private-installer-helm-terraform
author: Priya Patel
description: Automates KMS/HSM and TLS certificate rotation for private deployments by integrating Vault-sealed-secrets flows, HSM key wrapping, and Helm/Terraform hooks into the private-installer; includes upgrade/rollback safe paths, operator health checks, and an opt-in automation flag. Motivation: customers running Redwood Private requested automated credential and cert rotation to reduce manual ops and to meet compliance audits. This PR touches the installer control plane, terraform modules for KMS/HSM resources, Helm charts for the operator and sealed-secrets init containers, and adds end-to-end integration tests and migration docs.
commits: initial scaffolding for rotation controller and CRD (controller, CRD, api types)
terraform: add aws_kms_grant and hsm_cloud_hsm_cluster module hooks for rotation
helm: operator chart - init-container for sealed-secrets + vault-agent, templates for rotation configmap
installer: wire rotation controller in private-installer bootstrap and upgrade path
tests: add e2e harness using kind+localstack mocks for KMS and vault sealed-secrets
docs: rotation runbook and upgrade notes
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Can we add a feature flag to gate the HSM auto-wrap flow? Some customers want manual key promotion.
Priya Patel: Added 'rotation.autoEnableHSM' flag with default false and documented it in the runbook.
Xiao Li: The terraform changes create a KMS grant that may be too permissive; please scope it to the installer IAM role.
Priya Patel: Scoped the grant to the installer role and added a note in the module README about least-privilege recommendations.
Maya Rodriguez: CI failed on lint for charts; needs templating fix for values.yaml schema.
Priya Patel: Fixed Helm values schema and ran chart lint locally; CI passed on re-run.
ci_details: lint: success (go vet + staticcheck + helm lint)
release_notes: Added automated KMS/HSM key rotation and TLS certificate rotation support for Redwood Private deployments. Includes Helm chart updates, Terraform module hooks, an opt-in automation flag, upgrade/rollback safety checks, and runbook documentation.
